sources.outlet: Care Considered (Nursing Home Accountability Report, 2026 Edition)
sources.quote: For-profit facilities average 2.8 stars vs 3.57 for non-profits (a 0.77-star gap), and staff 0.71 fewer nurse hours per resident per day.
sources.searcher_note: Page says 'CMS data vintage Aug2026', no publication date. Its ownership table: Non-profit 2,868 homes at 4.4 nurse hrs/resident/day, 35.4% fined; For-profit 10,877 at 3.69, 47% fined. Same staffing finding and near-identical numbers; gives % fined, not fines per bed.

sources.quote: $188,781 Average fines/home Average total fines against affiliated homes. National average: $31,092
sources.searcher_note: Data as of August 2026. Arcadia Care affiliated with 25 facilities in Illinois and Ohio; fines per home about 6x national average; 3.2 nurse hrs/resident/day vs 3.9 national. Per home, not per bed; database page, not a story.

sources.quote: Multiple academic studies show the results, highlighting the lower staffing and quality in for-profit homes compared with nonprofits and government-run facilities.
sources.searcher_note: Investigation of for-profit chains: lower staffing than nonprofits; midsize chains (11-100 homes) have higher average fines per home. No hours or per-bed numbers; Arcadia Care not named. Republished by Kentucky Lantern, SC Daily Gazette, Civil Beat, GovExec (copies).

notes: Well-known story (novelty guess 1). Care Considered's 2026 report (CMS data Aug 2026, likely post-cutoff but page carries no date) has the same for-profit vs nonprofit staffing gap with nearly the same numbers (3.69 vs 4.4). It reports share of homes fined, not fines per bed. No source found with $320 vs $205 fines per bed or Arcadia at $1,357 per bed. ProPublica shows Arcadia Care at $188,781 average fines per home (national $31,092), August 2026 data. Local coverage of individual Arcadia Care homes exists (WCIA: Arcadia Care Danville fined over $100K by Illinois DPH) but WCIA returned 403 and could not be quoted. Consumer Voice staffing page (snippet: non-profits staff about 23% higher than for-profits) returned 403.
